vetSays.line: ⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. A Elder veteran.
The Elder Nevermore falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Nevermore!
📺 You brought down Elder Nevermore. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder Nevermore.
🛡️ Raj, Meera and Ingrid met them at the door — 3 put down. Raj, Meera, Ingrid are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Kurt, Ingrid. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Ingrid strikes the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes.
Kurt strikes the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes.
Ingrid strikes the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes.
Kurt strikes the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes.
The Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes, Ugly-Eyes (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
You catch Colin telling the fire about Kurt. "You brought down Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes, Ugly-Eyes (packmate)." The story's already growing.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Kurt, Lulwa, Leo, Raj and Jorge met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Leo, Raj, Jorge are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Kurt strikes the Scarred Nostalgia.
The Scarred Nostalgia falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Nostalgia!
📺 You brought down Scarred Nostalgia. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
🛡️ Kurt, Colin, Raj, Meera and Ingrid met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Kurt didn't come back. Colin, Raj, Meera, Ingrid are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Meera just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

regDeaths.name: a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
something huge, rooting in the underbrush
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
stripes flowing where no wind blows
